description: Baseline permissions for the main window. The app's own storage_read/storage_write commands need no entry here — capabilities gate plugin commands, not the ones this app defines. core:window:allow-destroy is needed because closing is intercepted to take a final backup, and the app then has to close the window itself. dialog:allow-open is the folder chooser for syncing, and only that: the plugin's save and message dialogs stay switched off.
